confidence_notes: I based the coffee, beer and restaurant meal prices on web searches of cost-of-living sites. Numbeo, updated around 2026, gave cappuccino about EUR 3.31 or 17.6 lei, a draft pint about EUR 2.90 or 15.5 lei, an inexpensive meal about EUR 11.24 and a mid-range meal for two about EUR 50. The Wise US version gave about USD 3.57 for a cappuccino and USD 3.35 for a half-litre draft beer. I converted the euro and lei figures to US dollars using approximate exchange rates from my own knowledge. Expatistan was lower but is based on only a few contributions. For cocktails, the search summary attributed 22-38 RON at a trendy bar to a 2026 budget guide, and Expatistan gave about 23 lei. The searches found no restaurant price for a glass of wine. I estimated it at about 20-25 lei using retail bottle prices (about 35-43 lei), typical restaurant markups and its relation to beer prices, so it is the least certain drink anchor. The accommodation prices are my own estimates from general knowledge, not from booking sites. They are for July and allow for summer and festival-season demand, so actual prices can vary widely, especially around large events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cluj-Napoca is a mid-sized university and tech city in Romania. Numbeo puts its restaurant prices close to Bucharest's, about 3% lower. For accommodation I compared it with other Central and Eastern European secondary cities such as Brasov, Timisoara and Debrecen, which are cheaper than capitals like Budapest or Krakow at a similar level of tourist demand.
